newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July grain, soy options expiration quiet.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July grain, soy options expiration quiet.

text.p: Options expiration for CBOT July grain and soy complex contracts was uneventful on Friday, floor traders said.
"I didn't see anything big one way or the other," said one veteran floor trader. "It was relatively nondescript in beans."
Some traders noted pressure on July soybeans tied to long liquidation of soybean calls earlier in the session.
In addition, an options trader said the premiums in corn and bean options were strong.
"They're (premiums) very close to where we'd call the highs in volatility," said a corn and soybean options trader.
At 1217 CDT, July soybeans were seven cents lower at $8.31, July corn was 1/2 cent higher at $2.65-3/4 and July wheat was down three at $3.34 per bushel.
